subject: Train timing decision
text: Can we fix the train plan before Thursday? I found a connection that gets us in at 4:15, but you wanted the earlier route because it might be cheaper. I understand the budget concern, though the later trip costs less time and leaves room if we miss the shuttle. The earlier one means we rush through lunch and still risk arriving after checkout. I have not booked yet, so if you want that option, send the exact fare now and I will compare receipts. Otherwise I will reserve my seat for the 12:30 train and send you the confirmation link this evening. We can also share a cab if it stops at your place first. Please confirm.
